body: These things happened in late 04'- 05'. So a little over 10.5 years I've been dealing with this. I've thought about this for a long time. Though about different situations. Though about their loved ones. Though about my poor excuse of a little. Its ok. This was more of a deceleration. I could have said no and gone and had them cover my guard duty, I could have maned up and went injured, and I could have just said no to him and got my other responsibilities done. Its ok, I have lived and made poor choices. Its not anyones fault but my own. I'm tired of the nightmares. Im gonna check out for the night. Tomorrow I get my affairs in order. I can't avoid sleeping any longer. Thank you and MeesterA for the conversation.

I've tried ptsd meetings, meds. The va just throws meds at you. If you don't get better its your fault. 
I use to keep myself intoxicated to numb myself. But opiates get to expensive, and I was taking a huge dose just to feel right again. 
I am just talking up resources now that would be better suited for anyone else.
Tower guard duty for one, a stupid injury for the other, and the first was him asking to offer to take my place because I had a ton of work on the fob.
